sections.name: File setup

sections.what: Brings in state and effect helpers and the stamp display piece, and marks the file for the browser.
sections.why: Needed for the reveal timer and the stamps.

sections.what: Sends a named event without waiting and without failing, as the lab events file does.
sections.why: Reason not stated in the code beyond its behaviour, which matches the lab events helper.

sections.name: DossierReveal
sections.title: Case-file reveal
sections.what: Starts the file closed, then opens it after 0.7 seconds, or immediately when reduced motion is requested. Shows the stamp and then the label and content.
sections.why: The code comment says no motion is used when reduced motion is requested.
sections.watch_out: The content is hidden until the timer fires, so it is absent on the first draw.

sections.name: ShareAlterEgo
sections.title: Share control
sections.what: Shows either an open-link and stop button, or a share button. Sharing creates a link and logs a share event. Stopping removes the link. A failed share shows an error message.
sections.why: The code comment says sharing is opt-in and can be revoked.
sections.watch_out: A failed stop leaves the link showing with no message.

summary: The Alter Ego case-file reveal and an opt-in share control.
purpose: Shows the fan's Alter Ego file with a short reveal, and lets them create or stop a share link.
why: The comments say the file opens classified and then is stamped revealed, and that sharing is opt-in and revocable.
how: The reveal starts closed, then opens after 0.7 seconds, or at once when reduced motion is requested. Shows classified or revealed stamps and the body. The share control creates a link on click and logs a share event, or deletes the link on stop, and shows an error if creating fails.
inputs: The label, child content, any existing share link, and button clicks.
outputs: The reveal, the open-share link button, the stop button and any error message.
risks: A failed stop shows no message. The share link is public while active, so the stop button is the only way to turn it off. The reveal is a fixed visual delay only.
debug: If the file never opens, check the timer and reduced motion setting. If sharing fails, check the share route response. If stop does nothing, check the delete route.
